rca_of_issue: BUG 1 RCA — Razorpay web checkout does not display UPI. Root causes: (1) The claimed code fix (config.display.blocks) is absent from BOTH RazorpayModal.tsx and payments.tsx::openWebCheckout — the review request's description does not match the current state of the code. (2) Even had the fix been applied to RazorpayModal.tsx only, it would have no effect on web preview since useRazorpay() branches on Platform.OS==='web' and instead calls openWebCheckout in payments.tsx which loads checkout.js directly (payments.tsx:107-108). (3) Possible secondary factor: the TEST merchant may not have UPI enabled in the Razorpay dashboard — this is dashboard-side configuration, independent of client code. Fix: add display.blocks + sequence to payments.tsx::openWebCheckout (primary) AND RazorpayModal.tsx (for native parity); verify UPI is enabled for the test merchant.
